description:
Create a technical control schematic for a hospital Air Handling Unit (AHU-1) using Diagrams.net (draw.io). 

1. Review the Sequence of Operations text file on the Desktop (`~/Desktop/AHU_Sequence_of_Operations.txt`) to identify required components and control logic.
2. Create a schematic diagram showing the airflow path (Mixing -> Filter -> Heating -> Cooling -> Fan) using appropriate shapes.
3. Add all specified sensors and control devices with their exact tags (e.g., 'SF-1', 'SAT', 'VFD-1').
4. Use SOLID lines for physical connections (ducts/pipes) and DASHED lines for logical control connections (e.g., Sensor to Valve).
5. Save the editable source file to `~/Diagrams/AHU-1_Schematic.drawio`.
6. Export a PDF version to `~/Diagrams/AHU-1_Schematic.pdf`.

Note: You may need to search for shapes or use basic shapes (rectangles/circles) if specific HVAC symbols are not immediately visible.
